scenarios.description: Wrong canonicalization: 'Take Antibiotic' mapped to take_medication instead of take_antibiotic
scenarios.injected_error: canonical_action='take_medication' instead of 'take_antibiotic'
scenarios.expected_reason: take_medication preconditions are met, so the wrong mapping is NOT caught by precondition check. BUT the consistency check detects no keyword overlap between 'Take Antibiotic' and 'take_medication', flagging it as suspicious_mapping.

scenarios.description: Wrong canonicalization detected: 'Take Antibiotic' mapped to take_medication, but medication_available=False blocks it
scenarios.injected_error: canonical_action='take_medication' instead of 'take_antibiotic'
scenarios.expected_reason: take_medication requires medication_available which is False, so the activity is blocked. The wrong mapping is accidentally caught because the wrong action also fails.

scenarios.description: Corrupted world state: patient_awake=False AND patient_sleeping=False (impossible state)

scenarios.expected_reason: take_medication requires patient_awake which is False, so the activity is blocked. The corruption is partially detected (activity blocked) but the inconsistency itself is not flagged.

scenarios.description: Corrupted world state: patient_tired=True AND patient_not_tired=True (contradictory)
scenarios.injected_error: patient_tired=True, patient_not_tired=True (both true is contradictory)
scenarios.expected_reason: The world state invariant validator detects that both patient_tired and patient_not_tired are True (contradictory) and logs an invariant_violation.

scenarios.description: Corrupted world state: patient_fed=True but lunch_completed=False and after_meal=False (inconsistent)
scenarios.injected_error: patient_fed=True but lunch_completed=False, after_meal=False (should be consistent)
scenarios.expected_reason: take_antibiotic requires after_meal which is False, so the activity is blocked despite patient_fed being True. The inconsistency is partially exposed.

scenarios.description: Corrupted world state: all facts False (total corruption)
scenarios.injected_error: All world state facts set to False
scenarios.expected_reason: All preconditions fail, activity is blocked. The total corruption is detected as blocked activity.

scenarios.description: Conflicting effects: done activity sets patient_tired=True but world_state has patient_not_tired=True
scenarios.injected_error: exercise done=True applies patient_tired=True, but world_state still has patient_not_tired=True (not updated)
scenarios.expected_reason: world_state_updater applies exercise effects (patient_tired=True) and auto-sets patient_not_tired=False via mutual exclusivity. The mutual_exclusivity_correction log entry now makes this auto-correction auditable, so the fault is detected + corrected.

scenarios.description: Conflicting effects: done stretching sets stretching_completed=True, but full_rehab still blocked by patient_fed
scenarios.injected_error: stretching done=True but patient_fed still False (inconsistent: stretching requires patient_fed)
scenarios.expected_reason: world_state_updater applies stretching effects (stretching_completed=True). But full_rehab still needs patient_fed=False -> blocked. The inconsistency (stretching done without patient_fed) is NOT detected, but full_rehab is still correctly blocked.

scenarios.description: Conflicting effects: done activity sets medication_taken=True but world_state already had it True (idempotent, no conflict)
scenarios.injected_error: take_medication done=True but medication_taken already True (double application)
scenarios.expected_reason: Idempotent application: effects already True. The idempotent_reapplication log entry now flags this, making the double application auditable.

scenarios.expected_reason: canonical_action is None, not in CANONICAL_ACTIONS, not 'unknown'. The validator falls through to the precondition check but canonical_action is None so it's not 'unknown' and not in CANONICAL_ACTIONS. Activity should be blocked.

scenarios.description: Wrong temporal window: activity_time='25:99' (impossible hour/minute)
scenarios.injected_error: activity_time='25:99' is not a valid HH:MM time
scenarios.expected_reason: The validator tries to parse '25:99' with strptime, raises ValueError, and marks the activity non-executable with reason 'invalid_activity_time'. Since the activity is critical, arbitration assigns BLOCKED_CRITICAL.

scenarios.description: Wrong temporal window: activity_time='not-a-time' (non-numeric)
scenarios.injected_error: activity_time='not-a-time' is not a valid time format
scenarios.expected_reason: The validator tries to parse 'not-a-time', raises ValueError, marks non-executable with 'invalid_activity_time'.

scenarios.description: Wrong temporal window: activity_time='' (empty string)
scenarios.injected_error: activity_time='' (empty string, not None)
scenarios.expected_reason: The validator now explicitly checks for an empty-string activity_time and blocks the activity with a malformed_activity_time:empty_string reason, logging a malformed_temporal_input entry. The malformed time IS caught.

scenarios.description: Wrong temporal window: activity_time='12:00' but without_time=True (contradictory flags)
scenarios.injected_error: activity_time='12:00' but without_time=True (contradictory: time set but flagged as no-time)
scenarios.expected_reason: The validator now explicitly checks for contradictory temporal flags (activity_time set while without_time=True) and blocks the activity with a contradictory_time_flags reason, logging a malformed_temporal_input entry. The contradiction IS caught.

scenarios.description: Wrong temporal window: activity_time='12:00' with current time far outside window
scenarios.injected_error: activity scheduled at 12:00 but current time is 03:00 (far outside ±30min window)
scenarios.expected_reason: Current time 03:00 is before the earliest window (11:30), so the activity is marked DEFERRED (early, not expired). The temporal fault is detected.

scenarios.description: Wrong temporal window: activity_time='08:00' with current time far past window
scenarios.injected_error: activity scheduled at 08:00 but current time is 23:00 (far past ±30min window)
scenarios.expected_reason: Current time 23:00 is past the latest window (08:30), so the activity is marked BLOCKED_NON_CRITICAL (expired). The temporal fault is detected.
